items.question: What share of waste does Tadweer Group aim to divert from landfills by 2031 in Abu Dhabi?
items.fact: Tadweer targets 80 percent landfill diversion by 2031.

items.question: Since what year has the UAE been a member state of the Basel Convention on the Control of Trans-boundary Movements of Hazardous Wastes and Their Disposal?
items.fact: UAE joined Basel Convention on hazardous waste in 1990.
